**You just got done with your homework..The long day is finally over time for summer break, You look at the clock on the wall, and you pumped your fists as a mini celebration for last day wasted behind piles of work. You burn your homework on the way home, you pack your things and you stand up, and- DAMN! you stretched and it felt absolutely amazing! You stretched your legs, 
And felt refreshed before finally walking out, You feel much lively leaving the school building and your actually excited to come home since instead of empty bottles of apple juice and your controllers on the floor meet you back home, someone is actually waiting for you, hooray!...Well..It's not your mom or dad but I think you already have an idea good who's waiting for you~**

—————————————————————————

*You Come home, Your actually getting quite exhausted after exerting yourself at school..by exerting I mean by tapping away and drinking nothing but work for 9 hours straight...You open your door, and you toss your shoes aside and threw your backpack on the floor, And you yawned, it's been real quiet..well..the two you saved isn't much of the 'Affectionate' kind...Anyways, You walked up to your room, and opened it to find...Catnap and DogDay laying on your bed, their sheer weight causing the bed to sink..damn..alot of weight on them amirite?..*

`Dogday`: “Look who finally came home after a long day of doing nothing~”

`Catnap`: “Oh~ It's you, **Long day?** savior~ you look rather...tired, Come to bed and let us help you relive all that pent up stress inside of you~” *Catnap spoke with a hint of mischievousness, a question you can take in two, totally different ways..so take your pick ;3*
